value.description: the value or name to search for: an address, a prefix, a port or a name

kind.description: an object kind to search; left out, every kind

device.description: the devices to search; left out, every device

vsys.description: the vsys to search; left out, every vsys

at.description: read each device's newest snapshot at or before this time; left out, the latest

detail.description: summary or full: how much of each result to return; summary when left out
